newEntry.name: Tip & Cascade
newEntry.desc: Snip forty runners, glue two calibrated keyed runway halves and stand eight crown-shaped tiles for a gentle chain reaction. Measured sheet/carrier reference, adjustable tile height and station pitch; local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL runway marks, connected-card and per-part STL/ZIP export. Adhesive required; cascade not physically tested.
